description: Extract dominant colours from a photograph using Colour Memory's proprietary k-means++ algorithm. Requires either a public image_url, or an image_id. A raw uploaded file with no public URL (e.g. a local file path or a ChatGPT file attachment without a usable download_url) is accepted as an image_id from ingest_image. Returns hex values with proportional weights. Optionally matches colours against the archive with style_context for coherent cultural naming. Its output feeds image_brief for an uploaded photograph.

analyse.description: If true, match colours against archive and return names

grey_card_hex.description: Hex from a grey/white card for white balance

image_id.description: Ephemeral image_id returned by ingest_image. Covers a local file path or raw file attachment with no public URL.

k.description: Number of colours to extract (3-12, default 6)

style_context.description: e.g. English cottage garden, Victorian, Japanese

name: extract_image_colours
title: Extract Colours from Image
